nodes.rationale: Registration never calls or starts automatically. Operator uses Call next player on admin Queue only when cabinet is ready; player then starts reserved game with physical button.

nodes.rationale: When simulator enabled without physical ESP32: Set simulator ready → Call next player → Start test round → Finish win/loss. Every action remains authenticated, explicit and server-validated; no page automatically runs a round.

nodes.label: Release test ticket affects simulator reservations only
nodes.rationale: Release test ticket is limited to a simulator reservation and is not recovery for an unresolved physical-device round.

nodes.label: Durable win loss alerts with focus-refresh polling
